files.purpose: Holds the composer's model/effort chip (ModelEffortButton), the popover behind it (ModelEffortPanel) that swaps between the effort slider card and the model picker list (ModelList with Hydra pair rows and model rows), and the ModelCatalog that decides which models the picker offers (the Settings modelList pins, or every available provider's models when that list is empty, with the thread's current model inserted at index 0 if missing). It also defines the effort slider itself: EffortSliderCard (fast-mode bolt, reset, effort title that opens the model list, model/pair name line, pair caption) and EffortSlider, a 34 pt capsule track with one 5 pt dot per level and a 42 pt Liquid Glass knob that snaps with haptics, whose filled part is coloured and animated per provider brand, fast mode and Hydra pair by TrackLook/EffortBrand/EffortPairBrand/EffortPalette and drawn by the TrackEffect Canvas (particles, speed streaks, lightning bolts, sheen, pair fusion seam). Choices made through the chip are written to the thread and remembered as per-model preferences in settings.

side_effects: Effort slider set: the card's index Binding setter (lines 628-633) runs `withAnimation(.snappy(duration: 0.2)) { effort = efforts[index] }`, and the panel's effort Binding setter (lines 204-210) runs `model.updateThread(thread.id) { $0.effort = effort }` then `remember(thread.id)` (setPreference + remember(model:effort:for:)). The setter is reached from DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0) `.onChanged` (lines 802-814): `let nearest = nearestStop(...)`; `if nearest != index { index = nearest; NSHapticFeedbackManager...perform(.alignment...) }`. So the thread write and both settings writes happen DURING the drag, once for every change of the nearest stop (a jump over several stops in one event writes once), not once on release; `.onEnded` (lines 815-817) only animates `dragX = nil`. Because minimumDistance is 0, a click on another stop writes on mouse-down. VoiceOver increment/decrement (lines 824-830) write the same way. A port must not defer persistence to drag end.
Fast toggle set: model.updateThread { $0.fastMode = isOn } then remember(thread.id).

remember(id): guard thread.model non-nil; settings.setPreference(ModelPreference(effort: thread.effort, fastMode: thread.fastMode), for: provider, model: modelID) and settings.remember(model: modelID, effort: thread.effort, for: provider).
Reset: effort = pair's orchestratorEffort if the model's efforts contain it, else nil; fastMode = false; then remember.

choose(entry): if provider differs, sets thread.provider and clears providerSessionID and providerResumeAt; sets model = option.id, effort = saved preference effort if in option.efforts else nil, fastMode = option.supportsFast && preference.fastMode; then model.leaveHydraPair(for:); if provider switched, existingRuntime(for:)?.stopSession(); settings.remember(model:effort:for:); settings.defaultProvider = provider.

Pair row tap (onEnterPair, lines 168-177): `model.enterHydraPair(pair, for: thread.id)`, `showsModels = false`, `dismiss()` closes the popover. The row is enabled whenever `!locked` (line 320, `isEnabled: !locked`), including while `isSelected`, so tapping the pair the chat already leads with runs enterHydraPair again; the code comment: "A tap on the pair the chat already leads with settles them again: it is the way back onto the pair's lead model and effort after the slider or a pair edit moved the chat off them."

Model row tap (onChoose, lines 165-167): `choose(entry, for: thread)` then `showsModels = false`, with NO dismiss(): the popover stays open and cross-fades (`.transition(.opacity)`, `.animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.12), value: showsModels)`) back to the slider card for the newly chosen model. Only a pair row closes the popover. The Back button (onBack) also only sets `showsModels = false`.

feature_notes: ModelCatalog.entries: settings.modelList empty -> flatMap availableProviders x models(for:); else compactMap pins through registry.model(pin.modelID, for: pin.provider) (unknown pins dropped). Thread's current model inserted at index 0 when not already present.

Chip width lock: naturalWidth is only recorded while lockedWidth == nil; on open lockedWidth = naturalWidth, on close nil, so the popover arrow does not move while effort title/name change; the name truncates instead. A compact chip hides the name, the effort title and the chevron but still shows the provider icon (or fused pair icon) and, when `thread.fastMode, current?.supportsFast == true`, the yellow bolt.fill, which sits outside `if !compact` (lines 77-81); it never locks width (`.frame(width: compact ? nil : lockedWidth)`).
Pair on chip: pair = model.hydraIsOn(thread) ? model.hydraPair(for: thread) : nil; the pair's customName replaces the model name.

ModelList: pairs shown only while Hydra is on (model.hydraPickerPairs). leadsWithPair: when any pair is led, no model row shows the checkmark. showsProviders when entries span more than one provider. Rows for another provider are disabled with "New chats only" when hasHistory.
Pair detail line: [modelsTitle only when customName != nil, providers, efforts] compactMap joined " · ".

EffortSliderCard.resolvedIndex: index of effort, else of defaultEffort, else of "medium", else 0. isMaxEffort = efforts.count > 1 && index == last. Slider index set wraps in withAnimation(.snappy(duration: 0.2)). The chip and the card can name different efforts for the same state: the chip (line 95) and helpText show `ModelOption.effortTitle(thread.effort ?? current.defaultEffort ?? "")`, while the card title uses efforts[resolvedIndex]. With thread.effort == nil and no defaultEffort the chip shows "Default" (effortTitle: `case "": "Default"`, Core/Models/Provider.swift:287) while the card shows the "medium" level (e.g. "Medium") or efforts[0]. This is upstream behaviour to keep. effortTitle (Provider.swift:284-290): `case "xhigh", "extra-high": "Extra High"`, `case "": "Default"`, default first letter uppercased; so the pair caption's lowercased heads effort reads "extra high".

titleStyle: with pair, LinearGradient [brand.titleColor] + pair.brand.titleColors (+ EffortPalette.fast if fast), leading->trailing; else (max,fast) -> gradient [brand.titleColor, fast]; (max,!fast) -> brand.title; (!max,fast) -> fast gold; else EffortPalette.title.
EffortPairLook.headsEffort = (pair.workerEffort ?? resolvedHeadsEffort) mapped to effortTitle(...).lowercased().

EffortSlider geometry: inset = 21 (thumbSize/2); step = (width - 42)/(count - 1) or 0; x clamped to [inset, width - inset]; fill width x + inset. Drag: first change animates dragX in .spring(response: 0.22, dampingFraction: 0.8), later changes set directly; nearestStop = clamp(round((x - inset)/step)); change fires haptic .alignment; end animates dragX = nil with .spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.78). VoiceOver increment/decrement clamp to [0, count-1].

TrackLook.kind: (max, fast) -> fusion; (max, !fast) -> supercharged; (!max, fast) -> fast; else plain. TrackEffect overlay shown when kind != plain or pair != nil, with .transition(.opacity) and .id(look.effectIdentity); effectIdentity for a pair ignores kind so the fusion clock does not restart.

TrackLook.fill: pair -> gradient [brand.fillColor] + pair.colors; plain Chrome.accent; supercharged brand.fill; fast fastFill; fusion gradient [fillColor, fillColor, fastFill]. glow: pair -> black.opacity(0.35) if light else last.opacity(0.7); plain black.opacity(0.28); supercharged brand.glow; fast fastFill.opacity(0.7); fusion fast.opacity(0.75). isLightFill = pair.isLight ?? (supercharged && brand silver). stopColor black.opacity(0.35) on light else white.opacity(0.6). spark = brand.spark only without pair and kind supercharged/fusion, else white.
EffortBrand mapping: .claude, .deepseek, .meta, .antigravity own; .codex, .cursor, .grok, .opencode, .opencodeGo, .devin, .copilot, .commandcode, .pi, .zai -> .silver; nil -> .purple.

EffortPairBrand: sendsHeadsElsewhere -> heads brand: antigravity gemini; silver [Color(white: 0.8), Color(white: 0.95)]; else [fillColor, titleColor]; isLight = brand.isLight. Otherwise first 4 HydraRoster.personas colours, isLight false. titleColors = colors mixed with white by 0.18.

TrackEffect: paused when reduceMotion or !FrontMonitor.shared.isVisible; frame interval 1/30 for supercharged without pair, else 1/60; skips drawing when width <= 8. Order (lines 1054-1067): drawFusion (when pair), particles (supercharged/fusion), streaks + bolts (fast/fusion), drawSheen(color: spark) (fusion). drawFusion itself ends with `drawSheen(context, size: size, time: time, color: .white)` (line 1334), so a pair at maximum effort in fast mode (kind .fusion with pair) draws the sheen TWICE, and since `spark` is `.white` whenever pair != nil (line 1018: `pair == nil && (kind == .supercharged || kind == .fusion) ? brand.spark : .white`) both sheens are white. A pair not in .fusion gets only drawFusion's sheen; a .fusion look without a pair gets one sheen in brand.spark.

Traits.build: particles count max(10, Int(width/5)), seed = index: height r1, speed 12+28*r2, radius 0.7+1.1*r3, start r4, brightness 0.22+0.5*r5, shimmerRate 2+3*r6. Streaks count max(5, Int(width/14)), seed index+100: length 10+20*r1, speed 110+190*r2, thickness 1.1+1.1*r3, start r4, height 0.2+0.6*r5, brightness 0.35+0.55*r6. random(i,t) (lines 1343-1346): `let value = sin(index * 12.9898 + trait * 78.233) * 43758.5453; return value - value.rounded(.down)`, i.e. x - floor(x), always in [0,1) even when sin is negative. A TypeScript port must use `x - Math.floor(x)`, not `x % 1` (which returns negative values and would break every particle, streak, bolt and spark position).
drawParticles: span = width + 8; x = (start*span + time*speed) mod span - 4; y = height*(0.16 + 0.68*h); shimmer 0.6+0.4*sin(time*rate + index); skip opacity <= 0.01.
drawStreaks: span = width + length + 12; x = (start*span + time*speed) mod span - length - 6; brightness*edgeFade(x+length); skip <= 0.02; rounded rect gradient white 0 -> white brightness.

drawBolts: 2 slots, seed slot+200, period 1.4+0.9*r1, offset r2*period, flash 0.26 s, intensity sin(phase/flash*pi), cycleSeed = seed + cycle*7.31, x = 12+(width-24)*r3 (skip if not in (6, width-6)), lean 3+3*r4; zigzag points (x+lean,3),(x-0.4lean,0.42h),(x+0.5lean,0.5h),(x-lean,h-3); glow stroke fast.opacity(0.9*intensity) width 4 blur 3, core white.opacity(intensity) width 1.5.
drawSheen: band 46, period 2.8 s, x = -46 + (width+92)*progress; slanted quad offset 10 at top; gradient color 0 -> 0.22 -> 0.

drawFusion (lines 1232-1335): seam = width*(0.5 + 0.13*sin(0.7t) + 0.05*sin(1.9t+1)); pulse 0.5+0.5*sin(2.4t); headsNear = heads.first ?? lead. Base gradient stops lead@0, lead@max(0,s-0.22), white.opacity(0.92)@s, heads from farStart = min(1,s+0.16) (single colour held to 1, else spread evenly to 1). Plasma: 3 bands (seed band+300; amplitude h*(0.12+0.16 r1), wavelength 30+34 r2, speed 22+34 r3, thickness 1.8+2.2 r4, phase = t*speed/wavelength*2pi), 2 streams each, path sampled every 3 pt with y = h/2 + amplitude*sin(x/wavelength*2pi + (toNear ? phase : -phase) + seed*(toNear ? 1 : 1.7)); plusLighter, blur 2.5, reach 0.55*width, clipped to its own side (near: x 0..seam, far: seam..width). Each side carries the OTHER side's colour: `let color = toNear ? headsNear : lead` (line 1283), so the near (lead) side streams the heads' colour and the far side the lead's; brightness 0.32+0.16 r5; gradient near [color 0 -> color brightness] from seam-reach to seam, far [brightness -> 0] from seam to seam+reach; StrokeStyle(lineWidth: thickness, lineCap: .round, lineJoin: .round). Sparks (lines 1299-1316): 22, seed i+400; life = 0.7+0.8 r1; age = (time + r2*life) truncatingRemainder life; progress = age/life; toNear = r3 < 0.5; speed = 28+74 r4; x = seam + (toNear ? -1 : 1)*speed*age; y = height*(0.18+0.64 r5) + 5*sin(age*8 + seed); radius 0.7+1.5*(1-progress); opacity = (1-progress)*(0.5+0.5 r6)*edgeFade(x), skipped when <= 0.01; colour `Color.white.mix(with: toNear ? lead : headsNear, by: progress * 0.8)`; filled ellipse. Seam glow: plusLighter blur 7 ellipse x seam-coreWidth, y -0.2h, w 2*coreWidth, h 1.4h, coreWidth 9+8*pulse, white.opacity(0.32+0.3*pulse); core rounded rect x seam-1.1, y 2, w 2.2, h height-4, cornerRadius 1.1, blur 0.8, white.opacity(0.5+0.4*pulse); then drawSheen in white.

files.purpose: Renders the queued follow-up (steering) prompts as a glass tab rising from the top edge of the chat composer, overlapping it by ThreadChangesTab.overlap, with a title line that folds and unfolds the list (fold state kept on the ThreadRuntime as followUpsCollapsed). Each FollowUpRow shows a number or link mark, a drag grip, attachment thumbnails, two lines of text and send/edit/delete buttons; rows are sent in order after the running turn. The tab implements live drag-reordering with RowDrag, pairing (bundling) a held row onto a neighbour by hovering its middle band, unlinking by pulling a linked row out, a seven-row height cap with internal scrolling, and a mouse-up monitor that ends drags SwiftUI fails to report.

files.purpose: Defines PromptEditor, the shared 520 pt wide editor body used to edit a queued follow-up or a sent message: a title, a ComposerTextView with Return-to-submit and Escape-to-cancel, the attachment list, a caller-supplied extra section, an add-files button with a recent-downloads popover and an NSOpenPanel fallback, and caller-supplied action buttons. It also defines PromptEditorPopover, an AppKit NSPopover wrapper with application-defined behaviour that hosts such an editor anchored to a pencil button (by NSView or by a window rect), follows its content size without re-showing, and dismisses on Escape or a click elsewhere in the anchor's window via local event monitors.
